faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.q1: What is the extra charge for large luggage?
faq.a1: Each large luggage item (over 20kg) incurs an additional fee shown on the tour detail page. This ensures comfort for other passengers and maintains vehicle capacity.
faq.q2: What if the number of passengers exceeds capacity?
faq.a2: Vehicle capacity is predetermined for each tour. If passengers exceed capacity, you'll need to book an additional vehicle or choose a tour with a larger vehicle.
faq.a3: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before departure. Cancellations less than 24 hours incur a 50% charge. No refund for same-day cancellations.
faq.a4: Yes! Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss custom routes, additional destinations, or other special requests.
faq.q5: What's included in the tour price?
faq.a5: Price includes AC vehicle, experienced driver, fuel, and parking. Destination entrance fees and meals are not included unless specified.
faq.a6: Most of our drivers can communicate in basic English. For fluent English-speaking driver requests, please let us know when booking.
